- This is the program that the posts on `main` write after PR #3464 (the grbl-family posts keep a repeated tool). No post script and no code changed.
- Run by the author on this head: `first_part_programs` 2 passed (it was 1 failed before), `first_router_part` 4, `grblhal_post` 9, `router_kind` 4, `cutting_router` 5.

This is the fix of a red `main` (#3572, #3574). The branch starts from the current `main`. Class: no refresh. I flag it ready and merge it now.
